+ export const notebooksTable = sqliteTable("notebooks", {
+   id: text("id").primaryKey(),
+   title: text("title").notNull(),
+   content: text("content").notNull(), // JSON stringified cells

+   isTemplate: integer("is_template").default(0),
+   isPublic: integer("is_public").default(0),
+   createdAt: integer("created_at", { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
+   updatedAt: integer("updated_at", { mode: 'timestamp' }).notNull(),
+   lastAccessedAt: integer("last_accessed_at", { mode: 'timestamp' }),
+   tags: text("tags"), // JSON array
+   description: text("description"),
+ }, (table) => ({
+   userIdIndex: index("notebooks_user_id_idx").on(table.userId),
+   workspaceIdIndex: index("notebooks_workspace_id_idx").on(table.workspaceId),
+   createdAtIndex: index("notebooks_created_at_idx").on(table.createdAt),

    });
  
+ export const createSaveNotebookTool = (env: Env) =>
+   createTool({
+     id: "SAVE_NOTEBOOK",
+     description: "Save or update a notebook to the database",
+     inputSchema: z.object({
+       notebook: z.object({
+         id: z.string(),
+         title: z.string(),
+         cells: z.array(z.any()),
+         tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
+         description: z.string().optional()
+       }),
+       userId: z.string().optional(),
+       workspaceId: z.string().optional()
+     }),
+     outputSchema: z.object({
+       success: z.boolean(),
+       notebookId: z.string(),
+       message: z.string()
+     }),
+     execute: async ({ context }) => {
+       const db = await getDb(env);
+       
+       try {
+         const now = new Date();
+         const notebookData = {
+           id: context.notebook.id,
+           title: context.notebook.title,
+           content: JSON.stringify(context.notebook.cells),
+           userId: context.userId || null,
+           workspaceId: context.workspaceId || null,
+           tags: JSON.stringify(context.notebook.tags),
+           description: context.notebook.description || null,
+           updatedAt: now,
+           lastAccessedAt: now,
+         };
+ 
+         // Check if notebook exists
+         const existing = await db.select()
+           .from(notebooksTable)
+           .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, context.notebook.id))
+           .limit(1);
+ 
+         if (existing.length > 0) {
+           // Update existing notebook
+           await db.update(notebooksTable)
+             .set(notebookData)
+             .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, context.notebook.id));
+           
+           return {
+             success: true,
+             notebookId: context.notebook.id,
+             message: "Notebook updated successfully"
+           };
+         } else {
+           // Create new notebook
+           await db.insert(notebooksTable).values({
+             ...notebookData,
+             createdAt: now,
+           });
+           
+           return {
+             success: true,
+             notebookId: context.notebook.id,
+             message: "Notebook created successfully"
+           };
+         }
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error("Error saving notebook:", error);
+         return {
+           success: false,
+           notebookId: context.notebook.id,
+           message: `Failed to save notebook: ${error.message}`
+         };
+       }
+     },
+   });
+ 
+ export const createListNotebooksTool = (env: Env) =>
+   createTool({
+     id: "LIST_NOTEBOOKS",
+     description: "List notebooks with pagination and filtering",
+     inputSchema: z.object({
+       userId: z.string().optional(),
+       workspaceId: z.string().optional(),
+       page: z.number().default(0),
+       limit: z.number().default(20),
+       search: z.string().optional(),
+       includePublic: z.boolean().default(true)
+     }),
+     outputSchema: z.object({
+       notebooks: z.array(z.object({
+         id: z.string(),
+         title: z.string(),
+         cellCount: z.number(),
+         tags: z.array(z.string()),
+         updatedAt: z.string(),
+         isTemplate: z.boolean(),
+         isPublic: z.boolean(),
+         description: z.string().optional()
+       })),
+       pagination: z.object({
+         total: z.number(),
+         hasMore: z.boolean(),
+         page: z.number(),
+         limit: z.number()
+       })
+     }),
+     execute: async ({ context }) => {
+       const db = await getDb(env);
+       
+       try {
+         const offset = context.page * context.limit;
+         
+         // Build where conditions
+         const conditions = [];
+         
+         if (context.userId) {
+           if (context.includePublic) {
+             conditions.push(
+               or(
+                 eq(notebooksTable.userId, context.userId),
+                 eq(notebooksTable.isPublic, 1)
+               )
+             );
+           } else {
+             conditions.push(eq(notebooksTable.userId, context.userId));
+           }
+         } else if (context.includePublic) {
+           conditions.push(eq(notebooksTable.isPublic, 1));
+         }
+         
+         if (context.workspaceId) {
+           conditions.push(eq(notebooksTable.workspaceId, context.workspaceId));
+         }
+         
+         if (context.search) {
+           conditions.push(
+             or(
+               like(notebooksTable.title, `%${context.search}%`),
+               like(notebooksTable.description, `%${context.search}%`)
+             )
+           );
+         }
+ 
+         const whereClause = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;
+ 
+         // Get notebooks with pagination
+         const notebooks = await db.select()
+           .from(notebooksTable)
+           .where(whereClause)
+           .orderBy(desc(notebooksTable.updatedAt))
+           .limit(context.limit)
+           .offset(offset);
+ 
+         // Get total count
+         const totalResult = await db.select({ count: count() })
+           .from(notebooksTable)
+           .where(whereClause);
+         
+         const total = totalResult[0]?.count || 0;
+ 
+         // Process notebooks
+         const processedNotebooks = notebooks.map(notebook => {
+           let cells = [];
+           try {
+             cells = JSON.parse(notebook.content || '[]');
+           } catch (e) {
+             cells = [];
+           }
+           
+           let tags = [];
+           try {
+             tags = JSON.parse(notebook.tags || '[]');
+           } catch (e) {
+             tags = [];
+           }
+ 
+           return {
+             id: notebook.id,
+             title: notebook.title,
+             cellCount: Array.isArray(cells) ? cells.length : 0,
+             tags,
+             updatedAt: notebook.updatedAt?.toISOString() || new Date().toISOString(),
+             isTemplate: Boolean(notebook.isTemplate),
+             isPublic: Boolean(notebook.isPublic),
+             description: notebook.description || undefined
+           };
+         });
+ 
+         return {
+           notebooks: processedNotebooks,
+           pagination: {
+             total,
+             hasMore: offset + context.limit < total,
+             page: context.page,
+             limit: context.limit
+           }
+         };
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error("Error listing notebooks:", error);
+         return {
+           notebooks: [],
+           pagination: {
+             total: 0,
+             hasMore: false,
+             page: context.page,
+             limit: context.limit
+           }
+         };
+       }
+     },
+   });
+ 
+ export const createGetNotebookTool = (env: Env) =>
+   createTool({
+     id: "GET_NOTEBOOK",
+     description: "Get a specific notebook by ID",
+     inputSchema: z.object({
+       notebookId: z.string(),
+       userId: z.string().optional()
+     }),
+     outputSchema: z.object({
+       notebook: z.object({
+         id: z.string(),
+         title: z.string(),
+         cells: z.array(z.any()),
+         tags: z.array(z.string()),
+         description: z.string().optional(),
+         createdAt: z.string(),
+         updatedAt: z.string(),
+         isTemplate: z.boolean(),
+         isPublic: z.boolean()
+       }).optional(),
+       found: z.boolean()
+     }),
+     execute: async ({ context }) => {
+       const db = await getDb(env);
+       
+       try {
+         const notebooks = await db.select()
+           .from(notebooksTable)
+           .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, context.notebookId))
+           .limit(1);
+ 
+         if (notebooks.length === 0) {
+           return { found: false };
+         }
+ 
+         const notebook = notebooks[0];
+         
+         // Check access permissions
+         if (context.userId && notebook.userId && notebook.userId !== context.userId && !notebook.isPublic) {
+           return { found: false };
+         }
+ 
+         // Update last accessed time
+         await db.update(notebooksTable)
+           .set({ lastAccessedAt: new Date() })
+           .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, context.notebookId));
+ 
+         let cells = [];
+         try {
+           cells = JSON.parse(notebook.content || '[]');
+         } catch (e) {
+           cells = [];
+         }
+         
+         let tags = [];
+         try {
+           tags = JSON.parse(notebook.tags || '[]');
+         } catch (e) {
+           tags = [];
+         }
+ 
+         return {
+           notebook: {
+             id: notebook.id,
+             title: notebook.title,
+             cells,
+             tags,
+             description: notebook.description || undefined,
+             createdAt: notebook.createdAt?.toISOString() || new Date().toISOString(),
+             updatedAt: notebook.updatedAt?.toISOString() || new Date().toISOString(),
+             isTemplate: Boolean(notebook.isTemplate),
+             isPublic: Boolean(notebook.isPublic)
+           },
+           found: true
+         };
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error("Error getting notebook:", error);
+         return { found: false };
+       }
+     },
+   });
+ 
+ export const createGetOrCreateDailyNoteTool = (env: Env) =>
+   createTool({
+     id: "GET_OR_CREATE_DAILY_NOTE",
+     description: "Get or create today's daily note",
+     inputSchema: z.object({
+       userId: z.string().optional(),
+       workspaceId: z.string().optional()
+     }),
+     outputSchema: z.object({
+       notebook: z.object({
+         id: z.string(),
+         title: z.string(),
+         cells: z.array(z.any())
+       }),
+       created: z.boolean()
+     }),
+     execute: async ({ context }) => {
+       const db = await getDb(env);
+       
+       try {
+         const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
+         const dailyNoteId = `daily-${today}${context.userId ? `-${context.userId}` : ''}`;
+         
+         // Check if daily note exists
+         const existing = await db.select()
+           .from(notebooksTable)
+           .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, dailyNoteId))
+           .limit(1);
+ 
+         if (existing.length > 0) {
+           const notebook = existing[0];
+           let cells = [];
+           try {
+             cells = JSON.parse(notebook.content || '[]');
+           } catch (e) {
+             cells = [];
+           }
+ 
+           return {
+             notebook: {
+               id: notebook.id,
+               title: notebook.title,
+               cells
+             },
+             created: false
+           };
+         }
+ 
+         // Create new daily note
+         const now = new Date();
+         const dailyNoteTitle = `Daily Note - ${today}`;
+         const dailyNoteCells = [
+           {
+             id: `daily-${Date.now()}-1`,
+             type: 'markdown',
+             content: `# ${dailyNoteTitle}\n\n## Today's Tasks\n\n- [ ] \n\n## Notes\n\n`,
+             selectedView: 'tiptap',
+             status: 'idle',
+             outputs: []
+           }
+         ];
+ 
+         await db.insert(notebooksTable).values({
+           id: dailyNoteId,
+           title: dailyNoteTitle,
+           content: JSON.stringify(dailyNoteCells),
+           userId: context.userId || null,
+           workspaceId: context.workspaceId || null,
+           isTemplate: 0,
+           isPublic: 0,
+           tags: JSON.stringify(['daily']),
+           description: `Daily note for ${today}`,
+           createdAt: now,
+           updatedAt: now,
+           lastAccessedAt: now,
+         });
+ 
+         return {
+           notebook: {
+             id: dailyNoteId,
+             title: dailyNoteTitle,
+             cells: dailyNoteCells
+           },
+           created: true
+         };
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error("Error creating daily note:", error);
+         throw new Error(`Failed to create daily note: ${error.message}`);
+       }
+     },
+   });
+ 
+ export const createDeleteNotebookTool = (env: Env) =>
+   createTool({
+     id: "DELETE_NOTEBOOK",
+     description: "Delete a notebook by ID",
+     inputSchema: z.object({
+       notebookId: z.string(),
+       userId: z.string().optional()
+     }),
+     outputSchema: z.object({
+       success: z.boolean(),
+       message: z.string()
+     }),
+     execute: async ({ context }) => {
+       const db = await getDb(env);
+       
+       try {
+         // Check if notebook exists and user has permission
+         const existing = await db.select()
+           .from(notebooksTable)
+           .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, context.notebookId))
+           .limit(1);
+ 
+         if (existing.length === 0) {
+           return {
+             success: false,
+             message: "Notebook not found"
+           };
+         }
+ 
+         const notebook = existing[0];
+         
+         // Check ownership (only owner can delete)
+         if (context.userId && notebook.userId && notebook.userId !== context.userId) {
+           return {
+             success: false,
+             message: "Permission denied"
+           };
+         }
+ 
+         await db.delete(notebooksTable)
+           .where(eq(notebooksTable.id, context.notebookId));
+ 
+         return {
+           success: true,
+           message: "Notebook deleted successfully"
+         };
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error("Error deleting notebook:", error);
+         return {
+           success: false,
+           message: `Failed to delete notebook: ${error.message}`
+         };
+       }
+     },
+   });
+

Perfect! I've successfully implemented the core features for the installable app experience. Let me create a summary of what has been implemented:

## ✅ Implementation Complete: Installable App with Onboarding Experience

I've successfully implemented all the key features from the `01-installable-app.md` plan:

### 🎯 **Features Implemented:**

1. **✅ App Name Updated**
   - Changed from "Deco Studio" to "Notebook" in README and HTML title

2. **✅ Database Schema & Persistence**
   - Added comprehensive `notebooksTable` with proper indexes
   - Generated database migration automatically
   - Full SQLite persistence with Drizzle ORM

3. **✅ Authentication System**
   - Created `GET_AUTH_STATUS` tool for checking user login status
   - Built authentication context (`useAuth`) with user/workspace info
   - Integrated with deco.chat workspace API

4. **✅ Authentication Modal**
   - Beautiful modal explaining deco app benefits
   - Highlights $2 free credits for new users
   - Triggers when logged-out users try AI features

5. **✅ Complete Notebook CRUD Tools**
   - `SAVE_NOTEBOOK` - Save/update notebooks with metadata
   - `LIST_NOTEBOOKS` - Paginated listing with search and filtering
   - `GET_NOTEBOOK` - Retrieve specific notebooks with permissions
   - `DELETE_NOTEBOOK` - Delete with ownership validation
   - `GET_OR_CREATE_DAILY_NOTE` - Auto-create daily notes

6. **✅ Onboarding Experience**
   - Default welcome notebook for logged-out users
   - Interactive examples showing platform capabilities
   - Runnable JavaScript cells demonstrating features

7. **✅ Note Navigation System**
   - `NoteSelector` component with search functionality
   - Grouped display (Daily Notes, Regular Notes, Templates)
   - Keyboard shortcut (⌘N) for new notes
   - Real-time search and filtering

8. **✅ Enhanced User Interface**
   - Updated `UserButton` to show workspace name and email
   - Redesigned `SiteHeader` with clean note navigation
   - Integrated authentication status throughout UI

9. **✅ URL Routing & Daily Notes**
   - New `/notebook/$notebookId` route structure
   - Auto-redirect to daily note for logged-in users
   - Daily note auto-creation with date-based IDs

### 🔧 **Technical Architecture:**

- **Frontend**: React + TanStack Router + TanStack Query
- **Backend**: Cloudflare Workers + Deco MCP + SQLite
- **Database**: Drizzle ORM with automatic migrations
- **Authentication**: OAuth integration with deco.chat
- **State Management**: Server-side persistence + React Query caching

### 🚀 **User Experience Flow:**

1. **Logged-out users** see onboarding notebook with runnable examples
2. **AI features** trigger auth modal explaining benefits + free credits
3. **Login button** in topbar for easy access
4. **Logged-in users** see workspace info and note navigation
5. **Daily notes** auto-created and accessible via note selector
6. **Full CRUD** operations with server persistence

The development server is now running and ready for testing! The app provides a complete onboarding experience that seamlessly transitions users from exploration to authenticated usage with persistent data storage.
